title: Enroll token, enroll-token/1 (DEC-0084)
description: The one-time token with which a machine that has no screen joins an estate (DEC-0084; DV-05 as amended by DV-CON-01). Fabric issues it: the statement is the signing register's enroll-token/1 (DEC-0063) and the signature a passkey assertion by a signing credential of the estate over its challenge. The node reads it from stdin or a file only its user can read, never from argv, a URL or a log. The hub binds its nonce to the joining machine's #sig key on first use and refuses every later use. It gives the machine no trust: a passkey-signed revision that lists the machine does. docs/specification/ceremonies.md.

scope.description: estate:<the estate record's estate id>: whose machines it lets join.

genesis.description: The digest of the estate's revision 1. The node pins revision 1's passkeys only when the chain it receives starts at this digest, so a chain forged around a copied public key is refused.

purpose.description: The only purpose this revision defines: a machine that hosts agents.

ceiling.description: null for none, or the digest of a ceiling document whose shape is not decided here (as limits/1 binds whatever document its digest names). Always present: a register type names one field list for good.

expiresAt.description: After notBefore, and at most 900 s after it (FAC-SEM-113).

nonce.description: 32 random bytes: the token's identity in the hub's ledger, bound on first use to the joining machine's #sig key fingerprint.

uses.description: One use (the single-use marker); the hub's ledger enforces it.

signature.description: A WebAuthn Level 3 assertion by a signing credential (sign.<domain>) the estate's current revision lists, over SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 form of the statement (signingChallenge).
